measurement_definitions.moments: Pooled over samples and coordinates; centered variance subtracts one pooled empirical mean.
measurement_definitions.pair_cosine: Uncentered cosine across feature coordinates for fixed physical observations 0 and 1; null if a vector is zero. A finite-width probe, not an ensemble expectation.
measurement_definitions.wide_gaussian_reference: Zero-bias Gaussian mean-field recursion starting from empirical input second moment and pair cosine; approximation for each finite network, also used as a wide-limit reference for orthogonal weights.
measurement_definitions.covariance_effective_rank: exp entropy of eigenvalues normalized by trace; covariance centers each neuron across 192 samples.
measurement_definitions.gradient: Backward propagation of the same seeded unit-norm vector through the hidden map for every sample; independent of readout/loss.
measurement_definitions.jacobian: Full width-by-width derivative of last hidden activation wrt embedded hidden input at probe sample 0. All singular values retained; rank uses width*float64_epsilon*smax.
measurement_definitions.relative_weight_update: L2 norm of this step's weight displacement / L2 norm of pre-step weights, per hidden layer; zero-start biases reported as absolute displacement.
measurement_definitions.feature_drift: RMS of current minus initialization activation on the same fixed probe batch, per layer.
measurement_definitions.selection: Choose lowest mean validation loss among learning rates with zero numeric failures. Population task/data fixed. Std uses ddof=1. Probe split is not used for selection.
